comments.text:
Homelessness such as this is a very hard situation to resolve, and very costly.

Governments dont want to fund much because most just get right back into it unless they volunteer early on and stick with the program.

The program requires a lot of hard work on their part, and most give up and go right back to the streets. 

Until all options are gone, no drugs available, no one to support their lifestyle by donating money, they dont have the will to quit. They go right back to panhandling, grifting, prostitution, or worse, its easier.

Unfortunately if a person has lived homeless like this for 3 months or more, the longer they have lived on the streets the less likely they are to be rehabilitated. Its sad to see. Tuff love helps. I dealt with 2, 1 rehabilitated after all his options dried up, the other  did not depite 5 months of help. She did not want to work, just be supported and do drugs. 

1st of all they have to want to get help, really want it. Otherwise its a crap shoot.
